newsitem.title: POLAND: BWR COULD ISSUE NEW SHARES FOR MERGER.
newsitem.headline: BWR COULD ISSUE NEW SHARES FOR MERGER.

text.p: Poland's Bank Wspolpracy Regionalnej SA (BWR) will decide by December 16 whether to issue new shares in its merger with smaller Bank Secesyjny SA, Secesyjny's president said on Tuesday.

After his bank's shareholders approved the merger on Tuesday Andrzej Oklejak told Reuters that BWR shareholders would vote on December 23 on whether to issue new shares or to buy shares for the merger on the stock market.
Oklejak said the merger with BWR, which currently holds 48.39 percent of Secesyjny votes, would likely be completed by the end of June next year.
"All (Secesyjny) shareholders unanimously accepted the motion to merge with BWR... (and) probably by the end of June next year the merger will be completed," Oklejak said.
Under the deal Secesyjny shareholders receive 25 BWR shares for each of their shares, with the exchange to be carried out no later than two months after the merger is officially registered.
Secesyjny's shareholders include the coal trader Centrala Zbytu Wegla Weglozbyt with 26.72 percent of shareholder votes and the Huta Katowice steel mill, with 19.15 percent.
